name: Codex Lens
tagline: Your Codex chats on Even G2
description: Use your own Codex account from Even G2 and R1. Setup: 1) open Codex Lens and use its visible Windows download link, 2) install the companion and confirm or sign into your own Codex account, 3) start the live QR scanner and point your phone at the companion QR. Then browse chats, hold the ring or temple to speak, or tap and scroll to type entirely on the glasses. No developer account is bundled. Your OpenAI login stays on your PC; prompts and replies are end-to-end encrypted.
author: Sam Wolfsdell

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect through the encrypted Codex Lens relay to the user's own desktop companion.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Capture a held-to-talk voice prompt and send it to the user's paired Codex session.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Use the phone camera as a live QR scanner to pair with Codex Lens Companion. No photo is saved.
